summary: Verified the new Joint Report Hub end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_hub_features.py (11 new tests covering /api/joint/config new subject keys, multi-subject POST /api/joint/reports & POST /api/joint/reports/professional, PATCH multi-subject 400 guard, /api/reports/complete for admin AND empty state for a fresh account, and a full multi-subject cycle including report generation with [subject] labels and PDF download). Fixed one outdated regression test (test_joint_reports.py had hardcoded 13 subjects; now 20). Full backend suite: 67/67 passing. Frontend Playwright: verified dashboard open-hub-link, /hub layout (10 main + 4 safety topic circles + both large circles), Focused vs Customized action title, hub-create-btn navigation with query params, hub-safety-circle preselects all 4 safety subjects, hub-complete-circle shows admin's 44 sections + totals, focused flow skips subject step to child step, mobile (<md) shows hub-mobile grid fallback. Complete report empty state validated via API (is_empty flag + 0 sections; frontend renders complete-empty testid).

integration_issues.issue: multi-subjects-line shows raw keys (e.g. 'safety + risk + safety_communication + safeguards') for the first ~200–500ms until /api/joint/config resolves, because JointNew.jsx renders before config load. Real users see it briefly flash before labels appear. Consider gating the line until subjects.length > 0 or fetching the config in a parent/lazy component to avoid the raw-key flash.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Gate the multi-subjects-line in JointNew.jsx behind `subjects.length > 0` (or a small loading indicator) so users never see raw keys during config fetch.

(Nice-to-have) /api/joint/reports and /joint/reports/{id} responses omit the `subjects` array in joint_public(); FE currently derives from URL params only, but adding it to the response would make the API self-describing and simplify future consumers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py resolve_subjects() correctly handles both `subject` (str) and `subjects` (list). However JointReportIn.subject is still `str` (required); technically the API contract could accept subjects[] alone. Currently frontend always sends both so no bug, but tests confirmed passing subjects[] without subject returns 422.
joint_public() does not include `subjects` array in the response; only `subject` (which is 'multi' for customized reports). Non-blocking but inconsistent with the input contract.
PATCH /joint/invitations/{iid} guard for multi-subject reports works (returns 400 'Subject change is not available for customized reports'). Verified via test.
CompleteReport.jsx correctly reads `is_empty` from backend and renders complete-empty testid; totals + section blocks render for accounts with completed data (admin: 44 sections).
